title: Gradient Inversion through Linear and Affine Subspace Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2611.13976v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Federated learning enables multiple clients to collaboratively train a machine-learning model without directly sharing their local datasets. However, as prior works have shown, the gradients exchanged during training may reveal sensitive information about client data. Most existing attacks usually optimize dummy inputs to match the true client gradients (Gradient Inversion Attacks), while some attempt to reconstruct them based on the observation that aggregate gradients from a fully connected (FC) layer are a linear combination of its inputs. In this work, we extend this observation by showing that aggregate gradients from an FC layer with the correct scaling are actually an affine combination of its inputs. We evaluate a gradient inversion attack that leverages either known linear-subspace information or its affine-subspace counterpart at each FC layer to improve reconstruction accuracy. translated_title: 通过线性与仿射子空间约束实现梯度反演
translated_abstract: 联邦学习使多个客户端能够在不直接共享本地数据集的情况下协同训练机器学习模型。然而，正如先前的研究所表明的，训练过程中交换的梯度可能会泄露客户端数据中的敏感信息。现有的大多数攻击方法通常通过优化虚拟输入来匹配客户端的真实梯度（梯度反演攻击），而另一些方法则基于全连接（FC）层的聚合梯度是其输入的线性组合这一观察来尝试重建数据。在本工作中，我们扩展了这一观察，证明经过正确缩放的全连接层聚合梯度实际上是其输入的仿射组合。我们评估了一种梯度反演攻击，该攻击在每个全连接层利用已知的线性子空间信息或其对应的仿射子空间信息来提高重建精度。我们的结果表明，基于子空间的方法能够……
tldr: 本文发现全连接层的聚合梯度在正确缩放下是其输入的仿射组合而非仅线性组合，并利用线性或仿射子空间约束改进联邦学习中的梯度反演攻击，从而提升数据重建精度。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that aggregate gradients from a fully connected layer, when correctly scaled, are an affine (not merely linear) combination of its inputs, and leverages linear or affine subspace constraints to improve gradient inversion attacks and data reconstruction accuracy in federated learning.
